long_biography.plain_text:
Deschênes trained as a mechanical engineer at the Université du Québec à Chicoutimi before establishing SMT Hautes Technologies in 2001. He led the company from printed-circuit-board assembly into integrated engineering, testing and electronics manufacturing. International sales, medical and controlled-goods certifications, and investment in traceability broadened both its markets and technical scope.

In 2023, the company became SMT Intelligence as the Fonds de solidarité FTQ made a minority investment to support growth. By then, its plants combined ten automated assembly lines with robotics and artificial intelligence. Deschênes remained majority shareholder and president through the transaction, then handed executive leadership to Christian Marcoux while staying chairman and a central figure in corporate development.
